description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractDittoHeaders that implements the DittoHeaders interface. It manages immutable header data, provides methods for accessing various header fields, and handles JSON serialization/deserialization. It also includes logic for authorization context processing and header truncation.

classes.name: AbstractDittoHeaders
classes.description: An abstract immutable class implementing DittoHeaders, managing headers as an unmodifiable map, providing accessors, JSON serialization, and header manipulation logic.

methods.name: AbstractDittoHeaders
methods.description: Constructor initializing headers map with authorization context processing.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID header value if present.

methods.name: getStringForDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves header value for a given header definition.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the Content-Type header value if present.

methods.name: getDittoContentType
methods.description: Returns the ContentType object derived from the Content-Type header.

methods.name: getSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema version from headers.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context, stripping issuer prefixes.

methods.name: getReadSubjects
methods.description: Returns set of read subject strings.

methods.name: getReadGrantedSubjects
methods.description: Returns set of granted authorization subjects.

methods.name: getReadRevokedSubjects
methods.description: Returns set of revoked authorization subjects.

methods.name: getChannel

methods.name: getBooleanForDefinition

methods.name: isDryRun

methods.name: getExpectedResponseTypes
